correctness.rationale: Independence of exponential holding times T_k and merger topology gives c_(n,r)=sum_k E[W_(k,r)]Var(T_k). With the established E[W]=k C(n-r-1,k-2)/C(n-1,k-1) and Var(T_k)=4/[k²(k-1)²], obtain exact sum. Repeated Pascal finite difference yields nonnegative binomial terms and a strictly positive k=j+2 summand in every permitted order; n=2 boundary and r endpoints included. Product-form expectation and uniform 8/[k(k-1)] majorant justify dominated convergence for r/n->alpha including alpha=0,1; sum gives g(alpha). Independent exact Fraction computations n=2..13 confirmed every defined alternating difference and c_n1=4/n,c_n,n-1=2/(n-1). Those finite checks do not replace infinite proof.
